programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 3
programme.desc: The Lemmings find an ice block outside the log cabin that holds a frozen prehistoric animal: a saber-toothed racoon. Softened, the Lemmings free the creature and try to tame it like a kitten. But the raccoon is like a whirlwind. Grizzy wakes up and discovers the cabin topsy-turvy and flies into a rage. But when the bear tries to kick the rodents out, the wild raccoon challenges him.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 3
programme.desc: By chance, Grizzy and the Lemmings discover a container filled with metal survival food flasks. Primarily filled with vegetables, they do not find favor with the bear, who is more interested in the hi-tech equipment at the rear of the container. Behind his back, the Lemmings find a flask of Yummy and skedaddle with it. But how will they escape Grizzy equipped with his sophisticated gear?

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 3
programme.desc: In a trunk, Grizzy and the Lemmings discover a big chocolate egg with a surprise inside. They are licking their lips. As they fight, they accidentally send the coveted egg flying amidst a group of penguins where a couple of winged creatures adopt it. They sit on the egg as if it were their offspring. Not intimidated, Grizzy and the Lemmings decide to get their hands on it, but the entire bird colony intervenes.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 3
programme.desc: The Lemmings open a nightclub with blasting music and a disco ball in an igloo they have built not far from the cabin. The noise prevents Grizzy from sleeping. The bear confiscates the disco ball and propels the Lemmings far into the distance. They land in an ice cave where they discover a console that lights up the stars in the sky and controls the northern lights. The canopy of heaven starts blinking. The Lemmings transform the ice field into an open-air discotheque!

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 3
programme.desc: The Lemmings come up with a ride worthy of a county fair in the living room. Awakened, Grizzy throws their juice extractor out the window and the rodents land in the neighboring science station where they accidentally wake up… a mammoth! A friendship is born between them. The Lemmings drag the mastodon into their game, and he transforms the entire cabin into a Ferris Wheel. Grizzy, who was trying to doze in peace, wakes up in a panic.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 3
programme.desc: Before an audience of penguins and walruses, two teams of Lemmings perform acrobatic high jumps, competing for the winning prize. When Grizzy accidentally jumps in, he quickly gets caught up in the game and the clapometer goes wild! Intoxicated by his victory, the bear is by no means a modest winner! But the Lemmings want their moment of glory in the limelight as well!

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 3
programme.desc: While Grizzy fishes, a penguin comes over and sees that the bear's bucket is empty. He decides to help him and catches piles of fish. Impressed, the bear brings the penguin back to the cabin, where a friendship rapidly strikes up. This pleasant and friendly new companion quickly arouses the Lemmings' curiosity. They lure the penguin away on the sly and replace him with another one who's not nearly as clever. Grizzy will quickly see through the trickery.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 3
programme.desc: Just as Grizzy settles into the couch by the fireside, the Lemmings come charging into the living room on their new mount, the vacuum cleaner. Irritated, the bear throws the mechanical charger into the fireplace, which blows up. Freezing air sweeps into the cabin. Seeking a source of heat, Grizzy decides to move into the science station greenhouse where the temperature is controlled by a drone. But the bear is unaware of what he carries in his luggage: the Lemmings!

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 3
programme.desc: The Lemmings have a new playmate: a walrus! The rodents ride the creature throughout the cabin, then make him slide down the roof before starting all over again. Grizzy steps in and propels the creature to the back of a mysterious ice cave. In the center is a dolmen with a bone sitting on it. Whoever touches the bone becomes docile and prehistoric in appearance. The Lemmings dream up a scheme where Grizzy would submit to their will.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 3
programme.desc: When Grizzy goes fishing, the Lemmings jump on the opportunity to transform the cabin into a giant ice slide. Upon his return, the bear puts an end to the rodents' bobsleigh party and gets ready to savor his day's catch. But the Lemmings steal his fish and draw the bear outside the cabin. Grizzy must try to recover his lunch while protecting his territory from a rodent invasion.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 3
programme.desc: Grizzy pinches a magic statue from the Lemmings that has the power to make objects appear in real life. All you have to do, is pin the photo of one's desires upon it. Too bad for the rodents' snow-bike! Grizzy replaces the vehicle's photo with the portrait of his beloved she-bear who stayed behind in Canada. Barely arrived in African, the she-bear disappears again, victim of the rodents' trickery. It is the outbreak of a bitter dispute.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 4
programme.desc: Mr Bean wants to take a photo of a rare bird, the Rosy Starling, hoping to win a cash prize from a nature magazine. But the special nuts he’s bought to lure the bird have instead attracted a couple of persistent squirrels, who keep hopping onto the bird table he’s installed and helping themselves to the tasty nuts. It’s Bean vs squirrels, or so he thinks…

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 4
programme.desc: Mr Bean buys himself a DIY remote-controlled boat kit so he can compete in a race on the local pond. But just as he’s about to finish it, Scrapper sniffs out some nearby sandwiches and causes havoc. In the confusion, Mr Bean thinks the cat has swallowed the rudder of his toy boat, so has to capture him and take him to the vet. Will he get his rudder back in time for the race?

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 4
programme.desc: Irma and Mr Bean are at the cinema to see the three hour long “Romance In Paris”, which Mr Bean is not looking forward to. But when he sees that they are also showing an action movie – Zombie Aliens 3 – he finds a way to sneak out and into the other screen. But will he get past the usher, and what will happen when Irma notices?

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 4
programme.desc: When a TV show offers cash to film in haunted homes, Mr Bean invites a film crew over and rigs his flat up to make it as spooky as possible – wobbly picture frames on wires, eerie noises on a tape recorder and a good old-fashioned sheet for a ghost. But will the tricks be convincing enough to win Mr Bean the money?

programme.title: Lamput - Season 3
programme.desc: Lamput spends the day at the beach, and, in a pair of swimming trunks, cuts a fine figure indeed. That is to say; a small, round and blobby figure. It only takes one snide comment from a fellow beach-goer to bring Lamput's body issues to the surface. When you're a shape changer, though, there's no need for exercise; before long Lamput is strutting along as an orange amalgam of all the best-looking sunbakers. On the up side, it's a handy disguise when the Docs come a-hunting. On the down side? Well, it's kind of tiring pretending to be someone you're not. Lamput learns an important lesson from a nearby blobby little girl. Be yourself, and if anyone's got a problem with that, they can go find their own patch of sand.

programme.title: Moley - Season 1

programme.title: Mush-Mush And The Mushables - Season 1

Flattered, our friends invite Bolly to choose his challenge to become an Adventurer too. Bolly will have to be the first Mushable to set foot somewhere. Mushton being crowded, Mush-Mush suggests they find an island, somewhere on the giant lake…

And again.

programme.title: The Tom and Jerry Show - Season 4

programme.title: The Tom and Jerry Show - Season 4

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 3
programme.desc: The Lemmings get hold of an old pinball machine and install it in the cabin. Their furious party interrupts Grizzy's nap and the bear threatens to break the contraption.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 3
programme.desc: Grizzy, a big chocolate lover, is growing a young cacao tree under an ultraviolet lamp. During a trampoline session, the Lemmings accidentally break the lamp, provoking a supernatural reaction.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 3
programme.desc: During a fight, Grizzy and the Lemmings stumble upon a Mayan temple lost in the jungle. Once inside, they set off a magic reaction that creates doubles of themselves at different ages.

programme.desc: Miguel is having one of those days! After finally tracking down Jack's missing harmonica, he barely has time to celebrate before Big Rex ambushes him, and a Compy makes off with the harmonica! And his day only gets worse from there! Sinking sand, man-eating plants, giant ants and volcano tremors only increases Miguel's fear of the jungle -- all of which he must overcome in order to save the day!

programme.title: Dino Ranch: Island Explorers - Season 1
programme.desc: When Bessie the Bronto takes a nasty tumble, her foot is injured. The pain has turned the gentle giant into a thrashing, dangerous dino who won't let anyone near her, not even Min! According to Jack, rare water plants called lazypads can calm even the most riled-up dinosaur! Jack, Min, and Clover hop into the Jungle Jetter and dive beneath the waves in search of the elusive plants!

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 1
programme.desc: Mr. Bean finds himself dogged by a young Japanese boy at the Science Museum. He takes an instant dislike to the Scallywag until he sees what the kid has in his backpack: gadgets so cool you can’t even get them in the West. So when a security guard tries to ruin their fun they run away together to... Mars!

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 1
programme.desc: Mr. Bean cannot, for the life of him, place the face of the uninvited fat bloke on his doorstep. An old school photograph and school cap just about jog his memory. By this time his new ‘friend’ has put his feet up and is eating Bean out of house and home. This blast from the past proves to be a blasted pain in the neck.

programme.title: Baby Lemmings - Season 1
programme.desc: Baby Lemmings cross a small obstacle course to get to the other side of a body of water. The Baby Lemmings find the course super fun! They get into the spirit of the game and enjoy completing the course over and over again. Baby Lynx discovers the course, but in crossing it she destroys it completely! The game is ruined for the Baby Lemmings, who set off in search of a new place to make the obstacle course even more fun.

programme.title: Baby Lemmings - Season 1
programme.desc: Baby Beaver is trying to build himself a winter home, but he just can't do it. His building keeps collapsing! A pebble from Baby Beaver's construction rolls up to the Baby Lemmings and introduces them to a new game: sliding pebbles up to a stick embedded in the frozen lake. The Baby Lemmings use Baby Beaver's stock of pebbles to indulge their new passion. Baby Beaver wants his pebbles back!

programme.title: Baby Lemmings - Season 1
programme.desc: The Baby Lemmings discover that blowing into a leaf makes sounds that light up and even make fireflies dance! Meanwhile, the cowardly and tired Baby Moose is looking for a place to sleep. But as soon as the moon gets hidden, his fear of the dark makes him tremble and prevents him from getting any sleep. When he spots the Baby Lemmings' fireflies, he decides to capture them to make a nightlight.

programme.title: Batwheels - Season 2
programme.desc: Clayface, Gotham City's messiest villain, arrives to cause trouble during Gotham's annual Clean Up Day. Redbird must overcome his fear of taking baths if he's going to help Bam bring Clayface to justice.

programme.title: Batwheels - Season 2
programme.desc: Buff makes a wish on a magic artifact for the other Batwheels to be turned into monster trucks, just like him! The rest of the Batwheels must learn how to use their big new bodies to undo the wish!

programme.title: Ben 10 - Season 3
programme.desc: When a mysterious electrical storm downs the Omni-Copter at the Equator, Team Tennyson soon discovers Solar and Polar are behind it.

programme.title: Ben 10 - Season 3
programme.desc: While taking in the sights and sounds of a Rio de Jenaro music festival, Ben bristles at Gwen's suggestion that she be his new sidekick, as the festival is threaten by the supersonic sound waves of Lord Decibel.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 2
programme.desc: Mr Bean goes to his favourite china shop to buy a new cup for Teddy but when he opens his wallet he doesn’t have enough money to pay for it. When he sees a poster for the local funfair where the stalls have cash prizes Bean is determined to win himself some money on the Coconut Shy. But after many unsuccessful attempts he realises it’s a fix and lets everyone know about it. Naturally this doesn’t go down well with the stallholder who wants revenge and a chase around the funfair ensues.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 2
programme.desc: Mr Bean’s electricity supply is cut off when Mrs Wicket sees the cost of her enormous electricity bill. As the snow falls outside Mr Bean’s flat becomes so cold that there are ice cubes in his bath water. Mr Bean has the idea to build a huge wind turbine in the back garden providing his own power. All is going very well until an unexpected storm sends Bean’s wind turbine into overdrive creating a huge surge of electricity and a huge shock for everyone

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 2
programme.desc: Mr Bean goes to his local bakery to buy a cake but finds he doesn’t have any money. He goes to the bank to use the cash machine but he can’t remember his pin number. When Mr Bean's bankcard is swallowed up by the cash machine there’s only one thing to do - go into the machine and fetch it back. The police are alerted but Bean’s main concern is to get some money and get back to the baker’s before all the cakes are sold.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 1
programme.desc: Sometimes Mr. Bean’s Teddy can be no fun at all. Feeling the need for a new friend, Bean buys a parrot. But getting the parrot past his landlady and her one-eyed cat, Scrapper, proves to be no easy task. Next, is trying to get the blasted bird to speak.

programme.title: Be Cool, Scooby-Doo! - Season 1
programme.desc: Daphne had always dreamed of meeting extraterrestrial life, but that dream becomes a nightmare when the gang gets caught up in the mystery of a scary alien monster and brought to Area 53 - a government facility so secret, it's two numbers higher than Area 51!

programme.title: Be Cool, Scooby-Doo! - Season 1
programme.desc: Shaggy takes the Gang to the Minor League Baseball stadium of his youth only to learn that it's about to be shut down because a Ghostly Baseball Player is scaring away the fans - and the team! Shaggy puts aside his cowardly ways to save his home team. But will Scooby stand by his (now not-so-scared) pal?

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 4
programme.desc: Grizzy and the Lemmings are hungry! While fighting over a jar of Yummy chocolate spread, the jar is destroyed. Grizzy and the Lemmings will once again fight over this new Yummy-based recipe: Choco-noodles.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 4
programme.desc: Grizzy and the Lemmings, who are both starving, discover a temple dedicated to an ancestral brioche. According to the book lying open inside the temple, to obtain a perfect brioche you must gather three gold ingredients and set them on the altar. When the panda idol who guards the temple receives the offering, the person will receive his favorite food in abundance. Grizzy and Lemmings set out to find the sacred ingredients but there is no question of working together. May the best critter win!

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 4
programme.desc: An integrated circuit containing an artificial intelligence accidentally connects to Grizzy’s stuffed teddy bear, which comes to life like a modern-day Pinocchio. Grizzy educates the chip until it decides to connect to the Lemmings’ robot to play with them. When the AI becomes a teenager, it is no longer interested in either Grizzy or the Lemmings and prefers using a smartphone to keep learning. Grizzy and the Lemmings join efforts to try and reset the chip’s memory and relive its childhood phase over and over.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 4
programme.desc: Grizzy and the Lemmings fight over a large silkworm that produces an extremely soft and resilient elastic thread ad infinitum. The Lemmings consider the worm the ideal game companion, but Grizzy needs the worm to make his knitwear. To become masters of the silkworm, the close enemies will go to harsh extremes.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 4
programme.desc: The Lemmings find a crate of cell phones: there’s one for everyone. But before being able to play with their new toys, they need to charge the batteries. This operation uses all the electricity stored in the cabin’s solar battery and prevents Grizzy from watching TV. Grizzy soon realizes that this is the least of his worries, for living with the Lemmings and their phones is a guaranteed nonstop stream of noise pollution.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 4
programme.desc: The Lemmings catch a grasshopper that can give you whatever your heart desires in abundance. All you need to do is set the grasshopper on its head while concentrating hard on what you want. As discretion is not the Lemmings’ strong point, Grizzy ends up understanding where their profusion of toys is coming from. Grizzy decides that it’s his turn to hunt down the grasshopper.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 4
programme.desc: When Mr Bean forgets Irma’s birthday, he asks Divya to help him build a snow sculpture in her likeness. It looks great, but the sun comes out and the sculpture starts to melt. Mr Bean decides to take it into his flat to protect it from the sun – but even that isn’t working. Will he be able to keep it frozen until Irma arrives?

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 2
programme.desc: Mr Bean needs to impress Irma who is infatuated with the hunky deliveryman. Bean tries to improve his physique at the gym but has little success. Instead he opts for an inflatable muscle suit. Irma is indeed impressed and Bean’s plan seems to be working – until the suit gets punctured and Bean makes the mistake of re-inflating it with helium. As Bean floats off into the sky will Irma’s admiration be punctured?

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 2

Bean starts to regret taking on a new best friend in place of good old reliable Teddy.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 2

Trying to make Mrs Wicket aware of the danger and save Scrapper and Teddy from being blown to smithereens takes courage nerve and a Bean styled homemade bomb disposal kit.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 1

programme.desc: The gang gets caught up in international espionage and intrigue when they cross paths with British secret agent, Jenny Vex, and must help her complete her dangerous mission of stopping an evil mercenary called Minus from killing breakfast.

programme.title: Tom and Jerry Gokko - Season 1
programme.desc: Jerry and Tuffy go to the Cheese Festival. Tom is cooking in the food truck and turns Jerry into a hotdog. Tom chases after Jerry and Tuffy as they escape.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 4
programme.desc: The Lemmings discover a new passion: magic Chinese lanterns that they use for sound and light performances. programme.desc: Forever Knight finally assembles his Round Table of young but super-powerful Knights, including... Ben?! With Ben's help, Forever Knight leads his new minions in an all-out attack on a Particle Accelerator.

programme.desc: While eating breakfast, the Baby Lemmings discover a hot stone near a spring that enables them to cook their food. They find it incredible and decide to start cooking. Baby Owl, asleep nearby, is attracted by the smell and plunders their feast!

programme.title: Be Cool, Scooby-Doo! - Season 2
programme.desc: Fred and the gang are called in to help with a mystery involving a figure from Fred's past, Professor Huh? Fred discovers Rose, with whom he learned mystery solving until they had a falling out, has also arrived with her gang.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 2

programme.title: The Tom and Jerry Show - Season 4

programme.title: The Tom and Jerry Show - Season 4

programme.desc: After discovering a gray hair, Spikes decides he's too old to be the alpha of the house which sends Tom into full bully mode. Jerry will have to act fast to convince Spike he's still the alpha dog.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 2
programme.desc: Grizzy finds himself unwillingly caught up in a race between two teams of Lemmings. When he understands the stakes, he tries to win but loses. Grizzy has his pride: he wants a rematch. He decides to build his own racing machine to challenge the Lemmings' soapbox.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 2
programme.desc: The Lemmings have placed giant remote-controlled hydraulic jacks under the cabin to transform it into a life-sized rolling ball game. Grizzy, who in inclined to seasickness, tries to put things back in place. The cabin tips over into empty space.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 2
programme.desc: Grizzy is disturbed during his nap by a few uncatchable flies which buzz incessantly around his head. When he realizes that the carnivorous plant upon which the Lemmings are playing rodeo feeds off flying insects, he decides to confiscate it and use it as an anti-fly weapon.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 2
programme.desc: The Lemmings have unearthed a crate of competition boomerangs. They rapidly become pros capable of disarming Grizzy at a distance and ejecting him from the cabin with disconcerting ease. To compete with the precision of the Lemming boomerangs, Grizzy decides to learn archery and becomes the Canadian William Tell.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 2
programme.desc: Exasperated by the Lemmings who prevent him from watching his favorite TV show in peace, Grizzy catapults them out of the cabin. One of them passes through the northern lights and undergoes a strange mutation: he now has the power to control metal with his mind.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 2
programme.desc: A strange new object figures prominently in the cabin: a big wall clock that resembles a Swiss cuckoo. Grizzy instantly falls in love with the regular tick-tock, which comforts and soothes him. But when the hands strike noon, figurines come out and perform a song and dance with a flourish. The Lemmings notice that by turning the hands of the clock manually, it can be noontime every two seconds.

programme.title: SuperThings: Rivals of Kaboom - Kazoom Power - Season 1
programme.desc: A battle among Superthings throws the new Kazoom Kids into a surreal world where everything they draw and erase... comes to life!

programme.desc: When MOE creates a new, super sparkly vehicle paint, the Batwheels decide to put on a talent show to see who will get a shiny new makeover!

programme.title: Bugs Bunny Builders - Season 1
programme.desc: The Looney Builders rush to build a soccer stadium in Mexico for their fast customer, Speedy Gonzalez.

programme.title: Bugs Bunny Builders - Season 2

programme.title: Bugs Bunny Builders: Hard Hat Time - Season 1
programme.desc: Bugs Bunny uses his excavator to dig in this music video as he tackles looney jobs across town.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 2
programme.desc: Mr Bean’s attempt to cut the grass is thwarted by a pesky root which refuses to budge. When Mr Bean breaks his spade he heads to the local Garden Centre to find a replacement. But instead of simply buying one he enters a gardening competition to win one - judged by none other than the Queen herself! Its gardening gloves off when Mr Bean goes into battle with his rival green-fingered competitors.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 2
programme.desc: Mr Bean and Irma are off for a day at the seaside. Irma is travelling light but Bean wants to take almost everything his owns in an enormous trunk. Arriving at the seaside Bean’s trunk gets accidentally swapped with a trunk belonging to a famous stage magician. As Bean entertains Irma pulling rabbits out of hats the angry magician arrives on the scene - and he’s not a happy bunny.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 4
programme.desc: Irma is dragging a very bored Mr Bean around a shopping centre when he spots a competition for Minty Mints – pull your silliest face for a photo and win a cash prize! Mr Bean tries to queue but it’s too long - so he persuades Irma to visit a photo studio offering romantic photoshoots. Can Mr Bean get away with pulling funny faces and submit the photo to the Minty Mints people without Irma knowing?

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 4
programme.desc: When Scrapper claws a rip in Teddy, Mr Bean rushes him to the Teddy hospital. As Teddy is being fixed, Mr Bean is rather taken with another Ted on sale in the shop. He decided to take Big Ted home with him once Teddy is fixed. But at home it seems as though Big Ted is freezing Teddy out, and after a particularly terrifying nightmare, Mr Bean realises he has to get rid of his new guest.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 3
programme.desc: Annoyed by the Lemmings' new magnetic train, Grizzy propels the whole lot of them far from the cabin. The rodents land in the neighboring hut of a sorcerer and a mysterious mask falls onto one of them, endowing him with the power of telekinesis. The Lemmings are thrilled! They return to the cabin to explore this new magic power. Perched upon pieces of furniture, they fly around the room to finish their life-size flying train game!

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 3
programme.desc: Grizzy chases after the Lemmings, who have loaded a jar of Yummy into their remote-control driven car. Where the bear gets to the gas station, he destroys the vehicle and recovers the chocolate spread. The rodents find little mini-cars and chase Grizzy all the way back to the cabin, where they trip him up and intercept the coveted jar. Helpless, the bear sets out after them, until he runs into a tank truck filled with Yummy.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 3
programme.desc: To recover the jar of Yummy that Grizzy confiscated from them, the Lemmings decide to infest the bear's coat with fleas. The scheme works and Grizzy starts scratching himself frenetically. Nonetheless, the bear manages to counter their diversion and expulse the rodents. When they land on a sorcerer's hut, the Lemmings take possession of a magic scepter that has the ability to temporarily shrink objects. Now microscopic-sized, the rodents return to the cabin to get their paws on the chocolate spread.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 3
programme.desc: Grizzy wakes up starving but the cupboards are empty. While the Lemmings play nearby with an elephant, the bear swipes their peanut reserves. Not at all pleased, the rodents decide to recover their bag of nuts and use the elephant's trunk like a powerful vacuum cleaner to hurl all sorts of objects at Grizzy. In the heat of the battle, the Lemmings discover a pack of fabulous peanut and chili pepper cookies that seem to make the pachyderm ultra-powerful.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 3
programme.desc: Grizzy is about to start eating the last remaining food in the cabin: cocktail snacks. But the sly Lemmings get there first. A fight breaks out but is quickly cut short by the unexpected visit of a wart hog. The pig devours the crackers and then, using his snout, detects a forgotten old package of candy under the bed, which he also proceeds to gobble down. Everyone realizes that the creature has the ability to find food. Grizzy and the Lemmings fight over who will follow the beast to track down food.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 3
programme.desc: In order to win a trophy filled with Yummy candies, Grizzy and the Lemmings take part in a safari photo competition on an animal reserve. They must capture the portraits of a number of wild animals that live in the park. It requires all their cunning to approach the elephant, wart hog and bat and take photos for the contest. But when it comes to the super-speedy, blue-necked ostrich, it's a different kettle of fish!

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 3
programme.desc: While Grizzy organizes a picnic alongside the pond, the Lemmings steal his jar of Yummy using water balls to discreetly advance underwater. Despite their equipment, the bear surprises the Lemmings and traps the rodents inside a waterproof ball which he throws far into the distance. An ostrich mistakes the ball for her egg and sits on it, waiting for the egg to hatch. The Lemmings are adopted by this new mother who is prepared to do anything to satisfy her offspring!

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 3
programme.desc: Chased by a raging elephant, Grizzy and the Lemmings are ejected from the cabin and land on a small nearby promontory. One of the rodents finds himself seated upon a throne-shaped boulder. A ray of sunlight illuminates him, and the savannah animals bow down before the Lemming king! But as soon as he leaves his royal seat, his powers disappear. Grizzy grabs the opportunity to plop down on the throne. Upon his orders, the other animals seek to provide him with every comfort, bringing the cabin, television and food closer. But the Lemmings put their feet down.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 3
programme.desc: Grizzy is brutally awakened by four Lemmings who are giving a grand percussion concert near the cabin, while the rest of the group dances to the rhythm. The grumpy bear puts an end to the festivities by propelling the Lemmings into the distance. When they land, they discover a magical djembe inside the trunk of a baobab tree. When the percussionists start playing again, the Lemmings and all the other wild animals are possessed by the demon of dance!

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 3
programme.desc: In the midst of a heat wave, Grizzy and the Lemmings fight over the fridge. The rodents want to transform themselves into ice cubes to glide across their super curling ice slide, while Grizzy wishes merely to lie down inside the nice, cool appliance. After literally breaking the fridge in two, the Lemmings discover a container of refrigerant and create a new giant curling sheet in the savannah. But Grizzy has not given up the idea of resting in a cool spot!

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 3
programme.desc: Grizzy has gone all out for his dinner guest, the she-bear. But just as he is about to kiss her… Vroom! In the middle of a mad car race, the Lemmings wake him up with a jolt! Dragged out of his slumber and swept away upon a vehicle, Grizzy finishes the race in a daze. Not far away, the Lemmings find a mask that can control dreams. Once Grizzy gathers his wits, he wants only to get hold of the object and return to the she-bear of his dreams. But the Lemmings have other dreams, like high-powered racing cars.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 3
programme.desc: Grizzy watches a documentary on salmon, whereas the Lemmings want to dance it up in the garage, nightclub style. TV versus music, the sonic war has begun! When a cloud passes overhead, Grizzy realizes that their respective gadgets run on electricity provided by solar panels. No more sun, no more electricity! He devises a plan whereby he will be the only one to access the energy, but the Lemmings have not said their last word!

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 3
programme.desc: A confrontation between Grizzy and the Lemmings leads to a room in the castle tower. The bear accidentally sets off a mechanism and discovers a large medieval magic trunk.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 3
programme.desc: When the Lemmings spoil Grizzy's meal with their new game, the bear evicts them far from the cabin.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 3
programme.desc: The Lemmings are holding a log throwing competition that stops short when Grizzy sends them soaring into the distance.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 4
programme.desc: Mr Bean offers to repair Mrs Wicket’s antique necklace, but when his back is turned Scrapper gets entangled and runs off with it around his neck. Mr Bean turns his flat upside before spotting the bejewelled cat and gives chase. But when Mrs Wicket sees Mr Bean’s abandoned flat in a mess, she thinks her necklace has been stolen by a burglar!

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 4
programme.desc: When Irma leaves Mr Bean in charge of her knitwear stall, he manages to tip all the jumpers into a muddy puddle. Panicking, he decides to take them all home to clean them in his washing machine. But somehow he ends up shrinking them all, so tries all sorts of ways to stretch them back to their original size before Irma finds out.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 4
programme.desc: Mr Bean spots a cool remote-controlled car Mr Paliwal is selling at a yard sale, so he sets up a tombola with his own stuff as prizes to raise some cash. He’s raffling off some not very good things from his flat - the star prize however is his green car, so lots of people are buying tickets hoping to win the car. programme.title: Diena po rytojaus
programme.desc: Siaubingi uraganai siaubia Los Andželą. Nematyta pūga siaubingai užgriūna Indiją. Greipfrutų dydžio kruša bombarduoja Tokiją. Niujorke temperatūra per vieną dieną svyruoja nuo kaitros iki stingdančio speigo. Netikėti staigūs klimato pokyčiai visame pasaulyje sukelia neregėto masto kataklizmus – žemės drebėjimus, milžiniškas potvynių bangas. Profesorius Edrienas Holas tyrinėja klimato pokyčius, kuriuos sukėlė pragaištingas „šiltnamio reiškinys“. Be to, jis privalo surasti ir išgelbėti savo sūnų, kartu su draugais įkalintą milžinišku ledo miestu virtusiame Niujorke. Prasidėjus nevaldomam visuotiniam bėgimui, herojus iškeliauja ten, iš kur visi trokšta kuo greičiau ištrūkti – į bekraštes ledo ir sniego platybes, netikėtai nusidriekusias ten, kur dar neseniai stūksojo modernūs didmiesčiai...

programme.title: Aš esu Rožytė

Rožytė Vilniuje nepasirodo. Vienatvės dienas praskaidrina atvykstanti fotografė Neringa.Dokumentinis filmas „Aš esu Rožytė“ kalba apie grožio gležnumą, žmogaus laikinumą, gyvenimo vaidmens pasirinkimą. Vilniaus Rožytės ir fotografės draugystės istorija, animacijos elementai, teatro personažai bei V. Kernagio dainos sukuria alegorinės pasakos atmosferą ir perteikia filmo metaforinę idėją – „Jei galime pasirinkti gyvenimo vaidmenis, ar gali kas suvaldyti laiką?“

programme.title: Ledynmetis. Susidūrimas
programme.desc: Išdykęs voveriukas Skretas ir vėl pridarys bėdų. Savo išsvajotą gilę jis randa įšalusioje skraidančioje lėkštėje ir bandydamas ją ištraukti iš ledo pajudina svirtį bei netikėtai išskrenda į kosmosą. Ten Skretas vėl neapsieina be nuotykių – prisidirba tiek, kad Žemės link pažyra daugybė meteorų. Šios „krentančios žvaigždės“ Žemėje gyvenantiems gyvūnams laimės neatneš. Jie turės kuo skubiau ieškoti, kur pasislėpti. Per mamutų Menio ir Elės vestuvių metines meteorai įbaugina susirinkusius svečius, tampa aišku, kad romantikos čia nebus, nors vestuvėms ruošiasi ir jų dukra, apie šeimos pagausėjimą galvoja Diegas, tik Sidas jaučiasi vienišas. Tad saugodami savo gyvybes Menis, Elė, Sidas, Diegas ir kiti palieka namus ir leidžiasi į ilgą kelionę, kurioje bus pavojų, rizikos, tačiau netrūks ir juoko, atradimų bei naujų, spalvingų draugų!

programme.title: Grafas Montekristas
programme.desc: Rašytojo Aleksandro Diuma romano „Grafas Montekristas“ įkvėptas filmas apie jauną vaikiną, patyrusį nežmonišką apgaulę. Savo vestuvių dieną Emondas Dantèsas suimamas už tai, ko nepadarė ir įkalinamas siaubingoje tvirtovėje. Tačiau likimas nusišypso ir pabėgęs iš salos kalėjimo, kuriame praleido 14 metų už tai, kad buvo neteisingai apkaltintas valstybės išdavyste, Edmondas Dantèsas grįžta kaip Montekristo grafas, kad atkeršytų jį išdavusiems vyrams.

programme.title: Išėjimo nėra
programme.desc: Reabilitacijos centre besigydanti Darbė trokšta tik vieno, - kuo greičiau pasprukti. Vos pasitaikius progai, jauna mergina pabėga nuo prižiūrėtojų ir vogtu automobiliu patraukia į gimtinę. Darbė skuba aplankyti sergančią motiną, bet užklupus pūgai keliai tampa nepravažiuojami. Nelieka nieko kito, kaip apsistoti atokioje kalnų poilsio aikštelės trobelėje ir laukti kol stichija nurims. Trobelėje Darbė susipažįsta su keturiais nelaimėliais, kurie dėl snygio taip pat buvo priversti nutraukti keliones. Matydama, kad su nepažįstamaisiais teks praleisti ne vieną valandą, mergina desperatiškai trokšta paskambinti mamai ir nuraminti ją, bet telefono signalas neveikia. Išėjusi į kiemą patikrinti mobiliojo ryšio stiprumo, Darbė netikėtai išgirsta keistus garsus. Viename iš aikštelėje stovinčių automobilių, mergina aptinka siaubo apimtą, pagrobtą vaiką. Dabar Darbė turi sukaupti visą drąsą ir sumanumą. Ji privalo išsiaiškinti, kuris iš nepažįstamųjų yra pagrobėjas. Ar išlaisvinusi mergaitę ji sugebės pasirūpinti jos saugumu? Galbūt name laukiantys žmonės yra susimokę ir visi stos prieš nekaltą vaiką ir Darbę?

programme.title: Kodused teaduseksperimendid
programme.desc: Kuidas teha ise kodus müstiliselt ägedaid teaduskatseid? Saatejuht Steve selgitab ning annab nõu.

programme.title: Teaduspauk
programme.desc: Teadus-mustkunstnik Eric jagab saladusi teaduse, tehnoloogia, inseneriteaduse ja matemaatika maailmast, et õpetada lastele, kuidas üllatada oma sõpru ja perekonda STEM-põhiste võlutrikkide ja käsitööga! Kujutage ette, et saate teha telefonile kõlarid vaid mõnest tavalisest majapidamises kasutatavast esemest või luua kõrgelennulise raketi pudeli, sooda ja veega. See kõik on võimalik läbi teaduse jõu!

programme.title: Ahne aju
programme.desc: Lõbus sari, mis süveneb meie maailma põnevatesse avastustesse, täis huvitavaid fakte ajaloo, teaduse, spordi, moe, isetegemise, retseptide, loomade ja maagia kohta.

programme.title: Matapauk
programme.desc: Eric Leclerc on matemaatik ja otsekui mustkunstnik näitab ta meile kui müstiliselt huvitav on matemaatika, mis peidab end kõikjal meie ümber. Matapauk õpetab väga lõbusal ja huvitaval kombel meid kõiki matemaatikat armastama.

programme.title: Lahedad loomad
programme.desc: Alates surfavatest hiirtest ja maalivatest koertest kuni rääkivate hobuste ning trühvlisigadeni. Kõige kavalamad, nunnumad ja pöörasemad loomad.

programme.title: Ajurünnak
programme.desc: Oled sa kunagi mõelnud, kas ilma tiibadeta on võimalik lennata? Või kõndida mööda vesiliiva? Kaks last esitavad võimatuna näiva väljakutse ning sukelduvad koos saatejuhtidega teadusmaailma.

programme.title: Noored kangelased
programme.desc: Põnev sari, kus lapsed võistlevad kahes suures väljakutses, mis on inspireeritud tõestisündinud kangelasteost.

programme.title: Andy metsikud seiklused
programme.desc: Andy ja Kipi metsikud seiklused viivad nad üle maailma veidrate ja imeliste loomade otsinguile.

programme.title: Hirmus ajalugu
programme.desc: See on energiline, üllatav ja tavapäratu kujutlus ajaloo kõige jubedamatest, kuid samas naljakamatest sündmustest. Muserdavatest maailmasõdadest ja kurvast keskajast võikate viikingite ning kihvtide kreeklasteni. Ajalugu pole kunagi olnud nii ulakas.

programme.title: Andy reisiseiklused
programme.desc: Andy, Jen ja Scout reisivad oma keskkonnasõbraliku masinaga mööda maailma ja avastavad looduse saladusi ning loomade uskumatut käitumist.

programme.title: Matapauk
programme.desc: Eric Leclerc on matemaatik ja otsekui mustkunstnik näitab ta meile kui müstiliselt huvitav on matemaatika, mis peidab end kõikjal meie ümber. Matapauk õpetab väga lõbusal ja huvitaval kombel meid kõiki matemaatikat armastama.

programme.title: Briti parim noor pagar
programme.desc: Kuulsaima küpsetussaate variant noorte meistritega. 9 - 13aastased noored annavad endast kõik, et saada oma oskuste ja originaalsete retseptidega maa parimaks pagariks.

programme.title: Vägevad masinad
programme.desc: Mootorrattur Grace istub juhiistmel ja tutvustab publikule maailma suurimaid, kiiremaid ja vägevamaid masinaid.

programme.title: Imeline Planeet
programme.desc: Selles kaasahaaravas teadussarjas avastab Jacques Cousteau kõige imelisemaid paiku Maa peal, Maa sees ja Maa kohal. Uskumatud rännakud meie imelise planeedi kõrgeimate mägede tippudest kuni sügavaimate paikadeni ookeanides.

programme.title: Loomade jutud
programme.desc: Lõbus ja hariv saade loomadest nii looduses kui koduaias. Igas osas saame teada huvitavaid ja üllatavaid tõsiasju ning mis kõige toredam, loomad ise räägivad endist...

programme.title: Joonistame koos: videomängud
programme.desc: Koomiksikunstnik Will Sliney näitab teile, kuidas joonistada imelisi videomängutegelasi! Olge valmis õppima hämmastavaid joonistamisoskusi.

programme.title: Loomaleksikon
programme.desc: Loomaleksikon viib nii lapsed kui ka pered teekonnale loomamaailma. Ookeani sügavustest kuni Aafrika südameni kohtuvad lapsed huvitavate, ainulaadsete ja põnevate loomadega, tutvudes nende elupaikade, ökosüsteemide, geograafia ja eriliste omadustega.

programme.title: Vasara Salamankoje
programme.desc: Nikola ir Rikė – viena kitą mylinčios seserys. Ilgus metus jos laikosi tradicijos išvykti drauge į kelionę ir taip sutvirtinti savo bendrystę. Šį kartą geradarė Nikola joms suorganizuoja išvyką į Salamanką. Per savo išsiblaškymą ji pamiršta seseriai papasakoti, kad kelionė bus skirta savanorystei. Ir toli gražu neprimins poilsio ir ramybės ištaigingame viešbutyje. Sužinojusi, kad dvi savaites teks miegoti pakeleivingose užeigose ir lieti prakaitą atkuriant Šv. Jokūbo piligrimystės kelią į Kompostelą, Rikė ne juokais įsiunta. Juk ji svajojo apie pramogas ir šėliones, o ne darbą ir nuovargį. Vis tik kelio atgal nebėra ir merginos kimba į darbus. Visa laimė, vakare laukia gardi vakarienė užeigoje ir malonūs pokalbiai su kitais savanoriais. Vienos vakarienės metu seserys susipažįsta su užeigos šeimininko sūnumis. Netikėtai įsižiebia simpatijos kibirkštys.Ar pažintis su užeigos šeimininko sūnumis padės išsklaidyti Rikės nepasitenkinimą atostogomis. O gal abi seserys atras savo antrąsias puses čia, Ispanijoje?

programme.title: Be namų
programme.desc: Serialas sukurtas remiantis Daivos Vaitkevičiūtės apysaka „Trise prieš mafiją“, kuri 2006 m. pripažinta „Metų knyga“ paauglių kategorijoje ir yra leidžiama vis naujais tiražais. „Be namų“ – tai gyvenimiška drama, kurioje susipina jautrūs vaikų likimai, detektyvinės mįslės bei nuoširdi draugystė, lydima įkvepiančių svajonių, linksmų ir šiurpių nuotykių. Serialo centre – vaikų globos namų auklėtinė Emilija ir jos draugai – našlaitis, pravarde Kobė, ir Kasparas. Šio tėvai mįslingai dingsta. Veiksmas rutuliojasi mažame Lietuvos miestelyje, kuriame daug saulės, bet mažai meilės. Vietinių globos namų auklėtiniai kasdien susiduria ne tik su geraširde direktore ir rūpestingu ūkvedžiu, bet ir su žiauria auklėtoja.

programme.title: Vasara Toskanoje
programme.desc: Mados žurnalistė Laura gedi avarijoje žuvusios motinos. Tvarkydama mirusios motinos daiktus ji randa lėktuvo bilietą į Pizą ir viešbučio adresą. Mergina nusprendžia leistis į kelionę, kuri padėtų suprasti, kuo gyveno jos mama ir pas ką ji norėjo skristi. Atvykusi į Italiją Laura susitinka su mamos meilužiu Emanueliu. Pasirodo, jų romanas truko 25 metus! Laura jaučiasi sutrikusi. Ar gali būti, kad ji visiškai nepažinojo savo motinos? Kaip mama galėjo išduoti savo šeimą dėl meilės eiliniam italui? Emanuelio sūnus Alesandras pakviečia Laurą į savo šeimos vilą. Viešnagės metu Laura žingsnis po žingsnio artėja prie tiesos. Tuo pačiu, ji pradeda tyrimą apie aukštąją Italijos madą. Paaiškėja, kad net aukščiausios kokybės rūbai gaminami varganomis darbo sąlygomis. Žmonių išnaudojimas slepiasi net po brangiomis etiketėmis. Kokias dar paslaptis Laurai atskleis kelionė į Italiją? Ar ji sugebės atleisti mamai?

programme.title: Gero vakaro šou
programme.desc: Nestokojant puikaus humoro čia kalbinami žymūs Lietuvos žmonės, netikėtais kampais atskleidžiant jų portretus. Justinas ir Mindaugas garantuoja, kad „Gero vakaro šou“ pokalbiai nebus nuobodūs, o svečiai kaskart sulauks labai netikėtų klausimų.

programme.title: Inspektorius Mažylis
programme.desc: Populiarus aktorius M. Jampolskis premjeroje atlieka pagrindinį – nedidelio miestelio policijos inspektoriaus Andriaus Mažylio – vaidmenį. Filme policininką visur lydi jo tarnybinis vokiečių aviganis, vardu Mažylis. Su šunimi į gimtąjį miestelį grįžęs dirbti Andrius po keleto metų, praleistų policijos akademijoje, randa labai pasikeitusią aplinką: dabar čia viską valdo nusikaltėliai ir korumpuoti vietos valdininkai. A. Mažyliui su bendravardžiu šunimi teks gerokai paplušėti, kad gimtinėje vėl viešpatautų tvarka ir ramybė. Filmo kūrėjai sako, kad šiame detektyve netrūks ir meilės istorijų, o siužetas bus įdomus visai šeimai: „Inspektoriaus Mažylio“ nuotykiai pasakojami su ironijos gaidele, humoristiniais pasisakymais, su šypsena žvelgiant į šviesiąsias gyvenimo puses.

programme.title: Ieškant dukros
programme.desc: Žiaurų likimo smūgį patyrusi Hidžran niekaip negali susitaikyti su kūdikio praradimu. Mintys apie gimdymo metu mirusią dukrelę lydi moterį kiekviename žingsnyje. Nors gydytojai ligoninėje teigė, kad kūdikis neišgyveno, Hidžran nuojauta kužda ką kita. Troškimas sutikti dukrelę dega jaunos moters širdyje ir suteikia jėgų gyventi.Vieną dieną Hidžran pamato šalikelje stovinčiame automobilyje dūstančią mergaitę. Moteris nelieka abejinga ir puola gelbėti mažylę. Nepaisydama savo saugumo, ji sugeba ištraukti negaluojančią mergaitę iš automobilio. Deja, netrukus pasirodžiusiam jos tėvui Emre ši situacija pasirodo labiau panaši į vaiko pagrobimą, nei į norą padėti. Hidžran sulaikoma ir ilgai tardoma dėl šio incidento. Laimei, peržiūrėję gatvę filmuojančių vaizdo kamerų įrašus, pareigūnai išleidžia Hidžran į laisvę. Mažosios Melek tėvas privalo atsiprašyti geraširdės moters. Jis puikiai supranta, kad tik Hidžran dėka jo mažoji dukrelė vis dar gyva.Sužinojęs, kad Hidžran ieško darbo, Emre nedvejodamas pasiūlo jai dirbti prabangiuose savo namuose ir būti Melek aukle. Mergina sutinka ir apsigyvena Melek šeimos dvare. Nuo pat pirmos akimirkos auklė pakliūva į siautulingą intrigų liūną. Šeimą skaldo dramatiškos paslaptys, kova dėl valdžios ir chaosas. Tačiau dabar visi likimo smūgiai tampa pakeliami, nes Melek ir Hidžran turi viena kitą. Mergaitės ir jos auklės tandemą apgaubia pasitikėjimo, pagarbos ir meilės skydas, nors jos net nenutuokia, kad yra motina ir dukra.

programme.title: Kas būtų, jeigu nebūtų Mėnulio
programme.desc: Kultinio režisieriaus Emilio Vėlyvio filmas įtrauks nuo pirmų akimirkų. Specialiųjų karinių pajėgų būrio smogikas Balys Stankus yra neabejotinai gabus snaiperis. Tačiau netikėtai nustatyta diagnozė išmuša jį ir jo artimuosius iš vėžių. Baliui nustatomas socialinio elgesio sutrikimas su vyraujančiu Aspergerio sindromu. Medikai rekomenduoja kariui užmegzti kuo artimesnius socialinius ryšius su jį supančia aplinka. Nepaprastos pastangos, stringanti savigyda ir kriminalinių nusikaltimų karuselė įsuka Balį į nežmoniškai pavojingą komiškų situacijų karuselę.

programme.title: Meilei nėra recepto
programme.desc: Darbšti ir maloni visiems aplinkiniams Paz Roble patiria siaubingą vyro išdavystę. Prasiskolinęs sutuoktinis vietoj išpirkos nusprendžia skolininkams atiduoti savo naujagimę dukrą. Dukrelės netekusi Paz nebegali rasti sielos ramybės ir nusprendžia visą savo laiką skirti dingusios mažylės paieškoms. Šeimos restoranas, kuriame Paz ilgus metus darbavosi, dėl skolų ir sutuoktinių barnių dabar stovi užkaltais langais.Sėkmingas verslininkas Estebanas Vila de Cortesas netikėtai tampa našliu. Mirus žmonai vyras lieka su trimis vaikais ir dideliu skausmu širdyje. Dar blogiau, kad jo anyta Elvira laiko jį kaltu dėl savo dukros mirties. Moteris dega keršto troškimu ir tikisi sužlugdyti Estebaną.Netikėta Paz ir Estebano pažintis vėl uždega abiejų širdyse viltį ir tikėjimą. Estebanas pasiūlo jai darbuotis jo namų virtuvėje. Paz nedvejodama sutinka su šiuo pasiūlymu, nes nieko kito taip nesiilgėjo, kaip vėl gaminti mylimiems žmonėms.Ar Estebano ir Paz jausmai atlaikys jų šeimų keliamus iššūkius? Kaip į Paz reaguos kerštingoji Elvira? Ar Estebanas sugebės apsaugoti mylimąją? Ar jis padės atrasti jai prarastą dukrą?

programme.title: Briusterio milijonai
programme.desc: Nevykėlis beisbolo žaidėjas Briusteris netikėtai sužino, kad mirė jo giminaitis. Pasirodo, šis buvo turtuolis ir paliko Briusteriui visą savo kapitalą. Tačiau turčius buvo tikras keistuolis, todėl Briusteris, norėdamas užvaldyti milžiniškus pinigus, turi per 30 dienų išleisti 30 milijonų. Manote, lengva iššvaistyti tiek pinigų? Visai nelengva, ypač kai niekam nė žodeliu negali prasitarti, iš kur juos gavai ir kodėl taip išlaidauji...

programme.title: Angelas sargas
programme.desc: Šivradžas ir Rasal – vienas kitą mylintys brolis ir sesuo. Netekę mylimos mamos, vaikai užgauliojami bendraamžių ir engiami kaimynų. Brolis jaučia didelę atsakomybę apsaugoti mažąją sesutę, tad tampa tikru apsaugos skydu kasdieniuose iššūkiuose. Gyvenimas pasisuka dramatiškai, kai vaiku tėvas patenka į avariją ir susiduria su paslaptingos ginkluotos grupuotės nariais. Dabar vaikams teks dar labiau saugoti vienam kitą. Ar meilė ir ištikimybė padės išlikti kartu klastinguose gyvenimo posūkiuose? Ar blogo linkintys niekšai palauš vaikų pasitikėjimą vienas kitu?

programme.title: Be namų
programme.desc: Serialas sukurtas remiantis Daivos Vaitkevičiūtės apysaka „Trise prieš mafiją“, kuri 2006 m. pripažinta „Metų knyga“ paauglių kategorijoje ir yra leidžiama vis naujais tiražais. „Be namų“ – tai gyvenimiška drama, kurioje susipina jautrūs vaikų likimai, detektyvinės mįslės bei nuoširdi draugystė, lydima įkvepiančių svajonių, linksmų ir šiurpių nuotykių. Serialo centre – vaikų globos namų auklėtinė Emilija ir jos draugai – našlaitis, pravarde Kobė, ir Kasparas. Šio tėvai mįslingai dingsta. Veiksmas rutuliojasi mažame Lietuvos miestelyje, kuriame daug saulės, bet mažai meilės. Vietinių globos namų auklėtiniai kasdien susiduria ne tik su geraširde direktore ir rūpestingu ūkvedžiu, bet ir su žiauria auklėtoja.

programme.title: Vasara Algarvėje
programme.desc: Jūrų biologė Julika Bergman po išsiskyrimo su mylimuoju nutaria mesti darbą Vokietijoje. Moteris keliauja aplankyti savo draugės Natali, o kartu ir pailsėti į Algarvėje. Vietinis investuotojas Simonas Greversas kreipiasi į Juliką konsultacijos dėl raudonojo koralo. Šis užsakymas suteikia moteriai viltį, kad bus galima įsidarbinti pagal specialybę ir įsikurti Portugalijoje. Julikos entuziazmo visiškai nepalaiko jos draugė ir bendras pažįstamas Migelis. Nardymo instruktoriumi dirbantis Migelis puoselėja šiltus jausmus Julikai ir linki jai tik gero. Vyriškis bando atverti Julikai akis ir įtikinti, kad Simonas yra ne kas kitas, o puikiai užsimaskavęs aferistas. Prisidengdamas domėjimusi aplinkosauga jis turi vienintelį tikslą – pelną. Ar Julikos patiklumas neatves prie nusivylimo? O gal Migelis su Natali klysta?
